name: plugin.artifact_generator
description: Interactive HTML report generation, Mermaid diagram visualization, and executive briefings
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: report_generate_html
entrypoints.description: Generate an interactive, responsive HTML report with charts and formatted tables

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: List of report sections ({title, content, type, data})

entrypoints.name: diagram_generate_mermaid
entrypoints.description: Synthesize valid Mermaid diagram syntax from nodes and edges

parameters.name: nodes
parameters.description: List of diagram nodes ({id, label, shape})

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: List of edges ({source, target, label, style})

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Flowchart direction (TD, LR, BT, RL, default: TD)

entrypoints.name: report_create_briefing
entrypoints.description: Create an executive markdown and HTML briefing summary
